Exercise 1: Examining the source

x-axis label: longitude
y-axis label: latitude

The colours represent each of the eight populations tracked and the routes they migrated respectively

The map is a Mercator projection and displayed locations are as follows: breeding site (circles), Iberian peninsula stopover (filled downward triangles), westernmost location during autumn migration (open triangles), nonbreeding area (squares), and post-Saharan crossing stopover (filled upward triangles)

Exercise 2: Examining the data

The longitude of Moscow is 36.7 degrees


Exercise 6: Select, de-duplicate and rename


```{r}

bird_migration_selected <- migration |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> distinct() |> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)

bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct()

```

Exercise 7: Filtering a data frame

```{r}

bird_breeding_sites_no_spain <- bird_breeding_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain") |> rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

bird_migration_selected_no_spain <- bird_migration_selected |>filter(Site != "Spain")

view(bird_breeding_sites_no_spain)
view(bird_migration_selected_no_spain)
```



Part 2: 

Exercise 1:

```{r}

bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_selected_no_spain|> group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |> summarise(
  Median_Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  Median_Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
) |> rename(Stopover_Latitude = Median_Stopover_Latitude, Stopover_Longitude = Median_Stopover_Longitude, Iberian_Latitude = Median_Iberian_Latitude, Iberian_Longitude = Median_Iberian_Longitude, Westmost_Latitude = Median_Westmost_Latitude, Westmost_Longitude = Median_Westmost_Longitude, Winter_Latitude = Median_Winter_Latitude, Winter_Longitude = Median_Winter_Longitude)

view(bird_migration_summary)

```


Exercise 2: Joining Data Frames

```{r}

bird_breeding_corrected <- bird_breeding_sites_no_spain |> filter()

combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_sites_no_spain, bird_migration_summary)

view(combined_bird_data)

combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)

```

Exercise 3: Subset data

```{r}

spring_variable <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")

autumn_variable <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% spring_variable)

autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |> filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_variable)

write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")

```
